summary: Executed frontend-only regression verification on public URL for critical homepage scroll behavior across desktop/mobile, hash policy, navigation-to-contact behavior, and ChatAssistant scroll containment. All requested flows passed.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for the requested critical scroll regression scope.

Optional observability note: browser logs show REQUEST FAILED net::ERR_ABORTED for /cdn-cgi/rum and occasionally /api/assistant/chat at teardown; no user-facing breakage reproduced in UI behavior checks.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code defects found in reviewed scroll/navigation/chat files for this scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://artbuild-design.preview.emergentagent.com. Desktop: root load scrollY=0, contact nav without URL hash, Accueil/logo return to 0, root refresh returns 0, intentional /#contact reaches contact, chat mount keeps page at 0, floating assistant prompt keeps window scroll unchanged while messages container scrolls. Mobile (390x844): root starts at 0, contact scroll works without hash mutation, Accueil returns to 0, intentional /#contact reaches contact. No in-page error selectors detected.
rca of the issue: Regression source appears correctly mitigated: embedded ChatAssistant now scrolls only its internal messages container (scrollTop) rather than using element-level scrollIntoView that could move the full document. Initial-load policy in index.js and App.js enforces explicit top-on-root and #contact-only hash targeting, preventing random restore-to-contact behavior on root refresh/open.
